name: Murchison Falls National Park
title: Murchison Falls National Park
subtitle: Uganda’s Largest Savanna & Dramatic Falls
description: Witness the world’s most powerful surge of water where the Nile squeezes through a 7-meter gorge. Home to 76 mammal species including lions, leopards, elephants, and Rothschild giraffes.
best_time_to_visit: December to February, June to September

name: Bwindi Impenetrable Forest National Park
title: Bwindi Impenetrable Forest National Park
subtitle: Ancient Rainforest & Mountain Gorilla Sanctuary
description: A UNESCO World Heritage primeval forest harboring over 459 endangered mountain gorillas. Mist-covered valleys, canopy walks, and intimate encounters with habituated gorilla families.
best_time_to_visit: June to August, December to February

name: Mgahinga Gorilla National Park
title: Mgahinga Gorilla National Park
subtitle: Where Gold Meets Silver - Volcanic Peaks & Golden Monkeys
description: Nestled in the Virunga volcanoes bordering Rwanda and DR Congo. Famous for habituated mountain gorillas, rare golden monkeys, and the scenic Lake Mutanda.
best_time_to_visit: June to October, December to February

name: Kibale Forest National Park
title: Kibale Forest National Park
subtitle: Primate Capital of the World & Chimpanzee Tracking
description: Home to the highest density and diversity of primates in Africa. Track habituated chimpanzee troops beneath the lush tropical evergreen canopy.
best_time_to_visit: December to February, June to September

name: Queen Elizabeth National Park
title: Queen Elizabeth National Park
subtitle: Savanna Biodiversity, Kazinga Channel & Tree Lions
description: Uganda’s most popular savanna reserve spanning volcanic craters, salt lakes, and savanna plains. World famous for Ishasha’s tree-climbing lions and Kazinga Channel boat safaris.
best_time_to_visit: January to February, June to July

name: Lake Mburo National Park
title: Lake Mburo National Park
subtitle: Whispers of the Wild - Zebras, Impalas & Boat Cruises
description: The closest savanna park to Kampala, celebrated for massive zebra herds, elands, impalas, leopards, and tranquil boat cruises on Lake Mburo.
